createToken(address,string,string,uint8,.details: When `recipient == address(this)`, the newly minted tokens are held in the launcher      and ANY caller can subsequently invoke `distributeToken` on them with arbitrary strategy      parameters. ONLY pass `address(this)` when this call is batched with `distributeToken`      in the SAME `multicall`

params.factory: Address of the factory to use
params.name: Token name
params.recipient: The address that will receive the newly minted tokens. See @dev above for the                  safety implications of passing `address(this)`.
params.tokenData: Extra data needed by the factory

returns.tokenAddress: The address of the token that was created

depositToken(address,uint160).details: Intended to be batched with `distributeToken` inside `multicall` so the deposited tokens      cannot be picked up by another caller. Requires the user to have set up a Permit2 allowance      for this contract

params.amount: The amount to pull (uint160 — Permit2 allowance type)

distributeToken(address,(address,uint128.details: The launcher must already hold `distribution.amount` of `tokenAddress`. The launcher      approves the strategy for that amount; the strategy is expected to pull the full amount      via `safeTransferFrom` inside its `initializeDistribution` call.      Always batch token-acquisition (`createToken` or `depositToken`) and `distributeToken`      in a single `multicall`

params.salt: The salt to pass into the strategy contract if needed
params.tokenAddress: The address of the token to distribute

distributeWithNative(address,bytes,bytes.details: Forwards `nativeAmount` with the call. There is no token leg, so nothing is approved.      The `nativeAmount`s across a batch MUST sum to `msg.value`; native left behind is not refundable.

params.nativeAmount: The native to forward with the call
params.salt: Domain separator, hashed together with the caller

params.originalCreator: The address that will be set as the original creator

returns.graffiti: The graffiti bytes32 that will be used

createToken(address,string,string,uint8,.notice: Creates a token via the configured factory.

depositToken(address,uint160).notice: Pulls `amount` of `token` from `msg.sender` into this contract via Permit2.

distributeToken(address,(address,uint128.notice: Distribute tokens already held by this contract via one or more strategies

distributeWithNative(address,bytes,bytes.notice: Runs a strategy that spends native instead of a distributed token

getGraffiti(address).notice: Calculates the graffiti that will be used for a token creation
